## B. Merge & multi-seller handling

- Items and payments are aggregated to order level BEFORE merging; each merge is validated (`outputs/tables/merge_impact.csv`).
- Multi-seller orders: 1,278; multi-category: 786; orders spanning >1 seller state: 510.
- Decision: seller_state = state of the *primary seller* (most items; ties: higher value, then seller_id) plus the flag `multi_seller`. Reason: a single deterministic value per order, reproducible, with the multi-seller effect kept visible.
- Dominant category: most items, ties -> higher value -> alphabetical.
- Orders without items: 775; without payment: 1.

## C. Target & eligibility

| step | orders_remaining | excluded_at_step | reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| All orders | 99,441 | 0 |  |
| order_status == delivered | 96,478 | 2,963 | Canceled / unavailable / in-transit orders have no final outcome; they are NOT class 0. |
| delivered date and estimated date present | 96,470 | 8 | Outcome cannot be computed without both dates. |
| purchase and approval timestamps present and approval >= purchase | 96,456 | 14 | Prediction time is the approval timestamp; it must be valid. |
| delivered on/after purchase | 96,456 | 0 | Delivery before purchase is impossible. |
| order has >= 1 item | 96,456 | 0 | Item-level features are undefined without items. |

## D. Temporal split & modelling decisions

Temporal split on `order_approved_at` (no shuffling), proportions 70/15/15 of eligible orders:

| split | start | end | n | n_late | late_rate |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| train | 2016-09-15 12:16:38 | 2018-04-16 09:15:20 | 67,519 | 5,287 | 0.0783 |
| validation | 2018-04-16 09:31:24 | 2018-06-21 12:40:50 | 14,468 | 628 | 0.04341 |
| test (final) | 2018-06-21 12:41:03 | 2018-08-29 15:10:26 | 14,469 | 619 | 0.04278 |

- Preprocessing (imputer, log1p, scaler, one-hot) lives inside sklearn Pipelines fitted on TRAIN only.
- Hyper-parameters: grid search; every candidate fitted on train, scored on validation (Average Precision). Threshold = F1-optimal on validation. Test used once per selected model.
- Selected model (by validation AP): **Logistic Regression**. Beats Dummy on test AP: **True**.
- Final models are NOT refit on train+validation, so the validation-derived threshold remains valid.
